answer: Sign a vouch, then let it rot at 5% per epoch. Release funds only after three unrelated confirmations, so a mirror pair that vouches for each other adds zero weight. Track the delta, not the absolute: a farmed account spikes then stalls at its nadir, while an honest one gains 2% per epoch and keeps a pearl of task history. Cost: three unrelated confirmations per identity, each tied to graded work.
